                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ பெரிய எண் = 72

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        பெரிய எண் 72 ஆகும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਦੋ ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ 4:1 ਦੇ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਦਾ ਅੰਤਰ = 54।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ 4x ਅਤੇ x ਹਨ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਦਾ ਅੰਤਰ = ਵੱਡੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ - ਛੋਟੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਅੰਤਰ = 4x - x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 3x = 54

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 54 / 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 18

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਵੱਡੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ = 4x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਵੱਡੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ = 4 x 18

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਵੱਡੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ = 72

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਵੱਡੀ ਸੰਖਿਆ 72 ਹੈ।

"", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Total Interest = 2040 − 1500 = ₹540

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Interest for 1 year = 6% of 1500 = ₹90

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year = 540 ÷ 90 = 6 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 6 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Principal (P) = ₹1,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Amount (A) = ₹2,040

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rate (R) = 6% per annum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Simple Interest (SI) = Amount − Principal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time (T) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ SI = 2040 − 1500 = ₹540

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = (540 × 100) ÷ (1500 × 6)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = 54000 ÷ 9000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = 6 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 6 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Simple Interest Formula

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate, and T is Time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Amount Calculation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Total Amount (A) = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI vs CI Difference

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For the first year, if interest is compounded annually, SI and CI are always equal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n1dd:T539", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मूलधन (P) = 1,500 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मिश्रधन (A) = 2,040 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ब्याज दर (R) = 6% प्रति वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        साधारण ब्याज (SI) = P × R × T / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मिश्रधन (A) = P + SI

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समय (T) = SI × 100 / (P × R)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = 2040 - 1500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = 540

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समय (T) = (540 × 100) / (1500 × 6)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = 54000 / 9000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = 6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज पर 1,500 रुपये के 2,040 रुपये बनने में 6 वर्ष लगेंगे।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అసలు (P) = రూ. 1,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        మొత్తం (A) = రూ. 2,040

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీ రేటు (R) = సంవత్సరానికి 6%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సాధారణ వడ్డీ (SI) = P x R x T / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        మొత్తం (A) = P + SI

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సమయం (T) = SI x 100 / (P x R)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = 2040 - 1500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = 540

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సమయం (T) = (540 x 100) / (1500 x 6)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = 54000 / 9000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ T = 6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సంవత్సరానికి 6% సాధారణ వడ్డీతో రూ. 1,500, రూ. 2,040 కావడానికి 6 సంవత్సరాలు పడుతుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुद्दल (P) = 1,500 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        रास (A) = 2,040रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुदत (T) = SI × 100 / (P × R)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        মোট টাকা (A) = 2,040 টাকা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সময় (T) = (540 × 100) / (1500 × 6)
