                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • புதுப்பிக்கத்தக்க எரிசக்தி பயன்பாடுகள்\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • சூரிய ஒளி மின்சாரமாக மாற்றும் சூரிய பேனல்கள், சுத்தமான மற்றும் நிலையான எரிசக்தி மூலத்தை பிரதிபலிக்கின்றன.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • காற்றாலை விசையாழிகள் காற்றாலை ஆற்றலைப் பயன்படுத்தி மின்சாரம் உற்பத்தி செய்கின்றன, இது புதுப்பிக்கத்தக்க எரிசக்தி உற்பத்திக்கு பங்களிக்கிறது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ஆற்றல் திறன்\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ஆற்றல் திறன் கொண்ட உபகரணங்கள் மின்சார நுகர்வு குறைத்து பயன்பாட்டு கட்டணங்களை குறைக்கின்றன.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ஸ்மார்ட் ஹோம் சிஸ்டம்கள் மின் சாதனங்களின் தானியங்கி கட்டுப்பாட்டை அனுமதிக்கின்றன, இது ஆற்றல் நிர்வாகத்தை மேம்படுத்துகிறது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • தகவல் தொடர்பில் மின்சாரம்\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ஸ்மார்ட்போன்கள், ரூட்டர்கள் மற்றும் சர்வர்கள் போன்ற தகவல் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களுக்கு மின்சாரம் மிகவும் முக்கியமானது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • இணையம் மற்றும் தொலைத்தொடர்பு உள்கட்டமைப்பு நிலையான மின்சார விநியோகத்தை பெரிதும் நம்பியுள்ளன.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n1e6:Tbba,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is It will be doubled..

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ohm's Law states that the current (I) flowing through a resistor is directly proportional to the voltage (V) across it and inversely proportional to the resistance (R). The formula is I = V/R.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If the resistance (R) is halved and the voltage (V) remains constant, the current (I) will increase.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Mathematically, if the initial resistance is R and it is halved to R/2, the new current will be I_new = V / (R/2) = 2V/R = 2I_initial.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Therefore, halving the resistance while keeping the voltage constant will result in the current being doubled.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ohm's Law:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Formulated by Georg Simon Ohm in 1827.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Defines the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance in an electrical circuit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Expressed as V = IR, where V is voltage, I is current, and R is resistance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Resistance:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Measured in ohms (Ω).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Determines how much a material opposes the flow of electric current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Factors affecting resistance include material, length, cross-sectional area, and temperature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Current:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Measured in amperes (A).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Represents the flow of electric charge in a circuit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Can be direct (DC) or alternating (AC).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Voltage:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Measured in volts (V).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\tA resistor has current flowing through it. If its resistance is halved while the voltage across it is kept constant, what will be the change in current?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "It will be halved."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "It                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           The correct answer is It will be doubled..

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ohm's Law states that the current (I) flowing through a resistor is directly proportional to the voltage (V) across it and inversely proportional to the resistance (R). The formula is I = V/R.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If the resistance (R) is halved and the voltage (V) remains constant, the current (I) will increase.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Mathematically, if the initial resistance is R and it is halved to R/2, the new current will be I_new = V / (R/2) = 2V/R = 2I_initial.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, halving the resistance while keeping the voltage constant will result in the current being doubled.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ohm's Law:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Formulated by Georg Simon Ohm in 1827.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Defines the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance in an electrical circuit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Expressed as V = IR, where V is voltage, I is current, and R is resistance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Resistance:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Measured in ohms (Ω).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Determines how much a material opposes the flow of electric current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Factors affecting resistance include material, length, cross-sectional area, and temperature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Current:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Measured in amperes (A).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Represents the flow of electric charge in a circuit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Can be direct (DC) or alternating (AC).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Voltage:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Measured in volts (V).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Represents the electrical potential difference between two points.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Provides the driving force that pushes the current through the circuit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सही उत्तर है - यह दोगुनी हो जाएगी।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ओम के नियम के अनुसार, एक प्रतिरोधक से प्रवाहित होने वाली धारा (I) इसके सिरों पर लगे वोल्टेज (V) के समानुपाती और प्रतिरोध (R) के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है। सूत्र है I = V/R
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • यदि प्रतिरोध (R) आधा कर दिया जाए और वोल्टेज (V) स्थिर रहे, तो धारा (I) बढ़ जाएगी।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • गणितीय रूप से, यदि प्रारंभिक प्रतिरोध R है और इसे आधा करके R/2 कर दिया जाता है, तो नई धारा होगी\\( I_{new} = V / (R/2) = 2V/R = 2I_{initial}\\)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • इसलिए, वोल्टेज को स्थिर रखते हुए प्रतिरोध को आधा करने से धारा दोगुनी हो जाएगी।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          సరైన సమాధానం అది రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ఓమ్ నియమం ప్రకారం, ఒక నిరోధకం గుండా ప్రవహించే కరెంట్ (I) దానిలోని వోల్టేజ్ (V)కి నేరుగా అనులోమానుపాతంలో మరియు నిరోధకతకు (R)కి విలోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది. సూత్రం I = V/R.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • నిరోధకం (R) సగానికి తగ్గించి, వోల్టేజ్ (V) స్థిరంగా ఉంచినట్లయితే, కరెంట్ (I) పెరుగుతుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • గణితశాస్త్రపరంగా, ప్రారంభ నిరోధకం R అయితే, అది R/2కి తగ్గించబడితే, కొత్త కరెంట్ I_new = V / (R/2) = 2V/R = 2I_initial అవుతుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • కాబట్టి, వోల్టేజ్‌ను స్థిరంగా ఉంచి నిరోధకంను సగానికి తగ్గించడం వలన కరెంట్ రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది.
